records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The Company’s operating revenue increased by 18.5 percent in the second quarter of 2024 compared to the same period in 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase resulted primarily from increases in shipments and tonnage partially as a result of the redistribution of freight due to a competitor bankruptcy.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The operating ratio (operating expenses divided by operating revenue) was 83.3 percent in the second quarter of 2024 compared to 82.7 percent in the second quarter of 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Additionally, increases in revenue were driven by improved revenue per hundredweight due to pricing and changes in business mix.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Consolidated operating income was $137.6 million for the second quarter of 2024 compared to $120.3 million for the second quarter of 2023.
